manage.title: Categories
manage.body: Built-in categories follow the app language, so they cannot be renamed. Archive one to hide it without touching anything filed under it.
manage.archivedHint: Hidden from the picker. Transactions already filed here keep it.
manage.deleteBody_one: One transaction uses it. Choose where it goes.
manage.deleteBody_other: {{count}} transactions use it. Choose where they go.
manage.deleteEmptyBody: Nothing uses it, so nothing moves.
manage.deleteNoTarget: Add another {{kind}} category first, so these have somewhere to go.
manage.methodsBody: A label you choose, and nothing else. Bookandry never asks for or stores anything from the card itself.
manage.methodSharedHint: Shared by everyone. Useful for joint rent, groceries and bills.
manage.methodDeleteClear: Leave them with no payment method
manage.methodRateHint: Used to price עסקת קרדיט on this card. Leave empty for interest-free.
